stages.discovery: The road narrows where it crosses a swift stream, and the crossing is blocked - felled trees and boulders piled waist-high, still slick with sap. Something enormous shifts behind the pile.

choices.label: Approach the Crossing
choices.description: Get a closer look at the blockade

choices.label: Watch From a Distance
choices.description: See what's guarding it before getting close
choices.outcome: A hulking, green-skinned shape hauls itself up onto the barricade, sniffing the air for the scent of anyone foolish enough to cross without paying its toll.

choices.label: Find Another Way
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the long way around is still a way

stages.ignore: You backtrack and find a longer route around the crossing, leaving whatever guards it undisturbed.

stages.discovery: A troll looms over the blockade, knuckles dragging, nostrils flaring at your scent. It doesn't look interested in negotiating a toll.
stages.sneak_success: The troll's nose swings past you without catching your scent, and you slip along the bank and around the blockade entirely.
stages.sneak_fail: The troll's head snaps toward you mid-step, nostrils flaring wide - it's caught your scent.
stages.ignore: You leave the crossing to the troll and turn back the way you came.

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Try to slip past along the bank

choices.label: Find Another Way
choices.description: Turn back and find a longer route
